Claims (9)
----------

The invention claimed is:

1. A compound of formula (I),

[![Figure US10016420-20180710-C00023](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/6f/64/ec/debdea99accbee/US10016420-20180710-C00023.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/6f/64/ec/debdea99accbee/US10016420-20180710-C00023.png)

 

wherein:

R1 represents a cyclic group selected from phenyl and heteroaryl1;

wherein each cyclic group is optionally substituted with 1, 2, or 3 substituents selected from halo, C1-6 alkyl optionally substituted with 1, 2, or 3 halogen atoms, phenyl, C1-6 alkoxy optionally substituted with 1, 2, or 3 halogen atoms, cyano, heteroaryl1a and heterocyclyl1a; and

wherein each cyclic group is optionally fused to a benzene ring or a 5- or 6-membered heteroaromatic or heterocyclic ring each containing 1, 2, or 3 heteroatoms selected from N, O and S; and when the group is substituted the substitution may occur anywhere on the optionally fused ring system as a whole; and

wherein heterocyclyl1a may additionally be substituted with oxo;

X represents a bond or CH2;

R2 represents H;

R3 represents H or CH2CH3;

Y represents a bond or C1-2 alkylene;

R4 is selected from methoxyphenyl, chlorophenyl, pyridinyl, 2,3-dihydro-1H-indenyl, dichlorophenyl, 2,6-difluoro-3-methylphenyl, naphthyl, benzylpyrrolidinyl and 5-methyl-3-phenylisoxazol-4-yl;

wherein heteroaryl1 and heteroaryl1a independently represent a 5- or 6-membered heteroaryl group containing 1, 2, or 3 heteroatoms selected from N, O and S; and

wherein heterocyclyl1a represents a 5- or 6-membered heterocyclyl group containing 1, 2, or 3 heteroatoms selected from N, O and S;

pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

2. The compound as claimed in claim 1, wherein R1 represents phenyl substituted with 1 or 2 fluoro, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

3. The compound as claimed in claim 1, wherein R3 represents H, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

4. The compound as claimed in claim 1, wherein Y represents CH2, and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof.

5. A pharmaceutical formulation comprising the compound as claimed in claim 1, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and a pharmaceutically acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

6. The pharmaceutical formulation as claimed in claim 5, further comprising one or more additional pain relieving agents.

7. A pharmaceutical kit comprising the compound as claimed in claim 1, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, and one or more additional pain relieving agents.

8. A method for inhibiting autotaxin activity in a mammal suffering from pain, fibrosis, osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, multiple sclerosis, atherosclerosis, thrombosis, psoriasis, neuropathy, cancer, or an inflammatory condition, comprising administering to said mammal a therapeutically effective amount of the compound as claimed in claim 1, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.

9. A process for the production of the compound as claimed in claim 1, which comprises reacting a compound of formula (II),

[![Figure US10016420-20180710-C00024](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/6d/01/87/2067fd03e9eb29/US10016420-20180710-C00024.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/6d/01/87/2067fd03e9eb29/US10016420-20180710-C00024.png)

wherein X, R1 and R2 are as claimed in claim 1, with an amine of formula (III),

[![Figure US10016420-20180710-C00025](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/e8/ae/71/2440519daf96aa/US10016420-20180710-C00025.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/e8/ae/71/2440519daf96aa/US10016420-20180710-C00025.png)

wherein Y, R3 and R4 are as claimed in claim 1.
